responsibility: Contains the user manual chapter for @command{gcov}, GCC's test coverage and line-execution profiling tool. It explains how coverage instrumentation is used, how @command{gcov} reads @file{.gcno}/@file{.gcda} data to produce reports, the available reporting and output-format options, interactions with optimization, data-file handling, cross-profiling relocation, and freestanding-environment workflows including profile streaming.
